name: wallet
title: Wallet
summary: Customer store credit with an auditable ledger (refunds to credit, goodwill credit within approval limits, price adjustments, use at checkout, expiry), gift cards, and a placeholder for loyalty rewards. Checkout and payments use the balance through the in-process public API.
owns: Store credit accounts and balance, made of credit lots with their source and expiry
Credit ledger: refund to credit, goodwill credit, price adjustment, gift card redemption, checkout hold, capture and release, reversal on refund of an order paid with credit, expiry, staff correction
Goodwill credit grants with reason, linked case or order, and approval above the staff member's limit
Holds at checkout (reserve while payment runs, capture on order acceptance, release on failure)
Gift cards: issuance in batches, codes, balance check, redemption into store credit, void and expiry
Loyalty points ledger (phase 4 experiment; designed, off)
notOwns: Card refunds and the choice of refund destination: payments and returns (they call creditRefund when the customer chose store credit)
Case decisions and remedies: support (calls grantGoodwill)
Accounting of the credit liability: finance (consumes wallet events)
Approval limits and second reviewers: access

publicApi.name: getBalance
publicApi.desc: Available balance and soonest expiry, for checkout step 4 'Use my Marketly credit'.

publicApi.name: holdCredit
publicApi.signature: (customerId: uuid, quoteId: uuid, amount: Money, idempotencyKey: string) => CreditHold
publicApi.desc: Reserve credit for a quote; earliest-expiring lots first. Fails with INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT.

publicApi.name: captureHold
publicApi.desc: Turn a hold into a use when the order is accepted.

publicApi.name: releaseHold
publicApi.desc: Release a hold on payment failure or quote expiry.

publicApi.name: extendHold
publicApi.desc: Keep a held credit hold alive while its payment is pending check (payments calls it from the status-check job until the result is known), so the hold does not expire into INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT at capture. Never shortens a hold; capped at pendingHoldMaxHours after the hold was made; a captured or released hold is returned unchanged.

publicApi.name: getLiabilityTotal
publicApi.signature: (asOf?: datetime) => { available: Money, held: Money, accounts: int }
publicApi.desc: Total store credit outstanding (available plus held) over all accounts, for finance's daily store_credit check against its liability

publicApi.name: creditRefund
publicApi.signature: (input: { customerId: uuid, refundId: uuid, orderId: uuid, amount: Money, reason: string }, idempotencyKey: string) => LedgerEntry
publicApi.desc: Refund to store credit (customer's choice) or return the credit part of a refunded order. Called by returns for return refunds to store credit and by payments for the refunds it executes (other origins with destination store_credit, and the credit part of a mixed tender). Idempotent per refundId; the payment tender split decides how much goes back to credit.

publicApi.name: grantGoodwill
publicApi.signature: (input: GoodwillInput, actor: Actor, idempotencyKey: string) => GoodwillGrant
publicApi.desc: Goodwill credit from a support case or order; above the actor's limit it becomes pending approval.

publicApi.name: getCustomerWallet
publicApi.desc: Staff view of a customer's credit: balance, lots, goodwill in the last 30 days against the per-customer limit, and pending grants (GET /admin/wallet/customers/{customerId}).

stateMachines.name: Credit hold
stateMachines.notes: A hold expires after holdTtlMinutes unless extended: while its payment is pending check, payments extends it (extendHold) up to pendingHoldMaxHours after it was made, so a slow bank answer never turns into INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT at capture. Captured credit returns only through creditRefund.

stateMachines.name: Goodwill grant
stateMachines.notes: Within the requester's goodwill limit the grant is approved immediately (pending_approval → granted in the same call). Above it, an access approval request is raised (e.g. Support limit $50, Finance $2,000). reverse removes unused credit only, with a reason.

stateMachines.name: Gift card
stateMachines.notes: Redeeming moves the full remaining value into a store credit lot (source gift_card). Expiry follows the law of the service region; default no expiry for sold cards.

endpoints.summary: Issue a batch of gift cards
endpoints.desc: Cards store only code hashes. The plain codes are delivered to the issuer once: GET /gift-cards/batches/{id}/codes (always available), and, when media is enabled, also as a private media document (usage gift_card_codes) in codesFileId. Both expire after giftCardCodesTtlHours; after the first download the encrypted codes are deleted. A batch waiting for approval has no codes until it is approved.

codesFileId.desc: Private media document with the codes (media enabled only), downloadable by the issuer until giftCardCodesTtlHours

endpoints.approval: Approval action wallet.gift-cards.issue. Batch total above the caller's limit needs Finance approval

endpoints.summary: Download a batch's gift card codes once
endpoints.desc: Only the staff member who issued the batch (or, for an approved batch, the issuer after approval), within giftCardCodesTtlHours. Returns the plain codes and deletes the encrypted copy, so a second call gets GIFT_CARD_CODES_UNAVAILABLE. Codes are never logged or put in the audit entry (only the batch id and count).

jobs.name: wallet.expire-lots
jobs.does: Expire lots past expiresAt (wallet.credit.expired); publish wallet.credit.expiring for lots expiryReminderDays (30 and 7) days before expiry, once per lot and reminder

jobs.name: wallet.release-stale-holds
jobs.does: Release holds past expiresAt (an extended hold's expiresAt is the extended time); delete undelivered gift card codes past giftCardCodesTtlHours

jobs.name: wallet.balance-check
jobs.does: Verify every account balance equals the ledger sum; report each difference to Finance's daily check with finance.recordExternalDifference (check store_credit, key = customer id + date; expected = ledger sum, actual = balance) when finance is enabled, otherwise log it

INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT.meaning: Available credit is lower than requested.

GOODWILL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.meaning: The customer's 30-day goodwill limit would be exceeded.

CREDIT_ALREADY_USED.meaning: The credit was already used and cannot be reversed.

GIFT_CARD_INVALID.meaning: Unknown, voided, expired or already redeemed gift card.

GIFT_CARD_CODES_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: The batch's codes were already downloaded, have expired (giftCardCodesTtlHours) or the batch is not issued yet. Void the batch and issue a new one if the codes were lost.

notes: Phase 3 (plan ch. 15 'later services'; ch. 7 'Coupons, Credits when supported'). The store-credit part of account/coupons and the 'Use my Marketly credit' checkbox in checkout use this module when enabled.
Money moves only through the ledger; every write is idempotent (refundId, Idempotency-Key) so a retry never credits twice.
Store credit used at checkout is a payment tender: payments records the tender split, and a later refund returns the credit part through creditRefund before any card refund.

Goodwill funded by a seller (e.g. late dispatch) is posted to seller earnings by finance from wallet.credit.granted with chargedTo=seller; platform goodwill is a company cost. Reversing a grant publishes wallet.credit.reversed with grantEntryId, chargedTo and sellerId so finance credits the seller back and reduces the liability; expiries and corrections carry their ledger entry id (entryId) for the same reason.

Gift card codes: plain codes exist only at issue time. They are kept encrypted on the batch (gift_card_batches.codes_ciphertext) until the issuer downloads them once (GET /gift-cards/batches/{id}/codes) or giftCardCodesTtlHours pass; with media enabled they are also written as a private media document (usage gift_card_codes, owner the batch) returned as codesFileId. Nothing keeps codes in process memory.

Balance differences: wallet.balance-check reports every account whose balance differs from its ledger sum to finance (recordExternalDifference, check store_credit); finance also compares its liability with getLiabilityTotal each day.
Granting access is not financial authority: goodwill and corrections use approval limits from access, never the permission alone.
dependsOn follows the architecture doc (customers, payments); access is optional only so the module can boot alone in tests — production requires it for limits.
